payload.reason: The evidence provides clear insights into the practical application of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity set expansion (ESE) methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: The MAP at gold-k (k g ) metric is designed to evaluate ESE methods in scenarios where coverage of multifaceted and vague entities is crucial, thus providing a more comprehensive assessment than fixed k metrics.
Using MAP at gold-k allows for adaptation to different concept sizes and provides an estimate of recall, which is essential for assessing effectiveness in real-world applications.
The evaluation at k g reveals performance drops of ESE methods, indicating that existing metrics may overestimate their effectiveness, especially in user-generated contexts.
